## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the issue or user need and what changes. Link the issue if applicable.

## Compatibility and boundaries

Describe changes to APIs, configuration, defaults, stored state, or security boundaries. Include a permitted scenario as well as the blocked scenario for a security change.

## Verification

List commands and results, including skipped checks and required environments. Distinguish local fixtures from live or deployment acceptance. Link relevant documentation or sanitized evidence.

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/MakazhanAlpamys/soup-wall/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) for the contribution workflow. Use synthetic examples; report vulnerabilities privately through [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/MakazhanAlpamys/soup-wall/blob/main/SECURITY.md).
